lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜，我可不会轻易放过你！
lines.en: Rustle rustle, you won't escape me so easily!

lines.zh: 这里的空气味道不对劲，快跑！
lines.en: Something's off in the air, run!

lines.zh: 洞穴深处，我的乐趣才刚刚开始！
lines.en: The fun only begins deep in the caves.

lines.zh: 你这脚步声，让我感觉到了恐惧！
lines.en: Your footsteps send shivers down my spine.

lines.zh: 我可不想让你成为第一个，你懂的。
lines.en: I don't want to be your first, you know what I mean.

lines.zh: 这里，就是我们共舞的地方！
lines.en: This is where we dance, together.

lines.zh: 你的味道，就像是久违的美食！
lines.en: Your scent is like a long-lost delicacy.

lines.zh: 探索者，这是你最好的礼物！
lines.en: Explorer, this is your finest gift.

lines.zh: 这里没有出路，只有我，和死亡！
lines.en: There is no escape, just me and death here.

lines.zh: 跟我走吧，我会带你去更好的地方！
lines.en: Follow me, I'll take you to a better place.

lines.zh: 我的触须在石壁上拖行。
lines.en: My tendrils drag along the stone wall.
The deeper it goes, the happier my steps.

lines.zh: 孤独的夜晚，我的故事更加精彩！
lines.en: On lonely nights, my tales are more enchanting.
In the caves, I am never alone.

lines.zh: 我只需等待，机会总会来的！
lines.en: I only wait, chances will come my way.

lines.zh: 这里是我的领地，你别想离开！
lines.en: This is my territory, you won't be leaving.

lines.zh: 寂静中，我的存在更加清晰！
lines.en: In silence, my presence is clearer.

lines.zh: 在这洞穴深处，我是唯一的守望者！
lines.en: In these deep caves, I am the lone watcher.

lines.zh: 孤独的夜晚，我唯一的伙伴就是黑暗！
lines.en: On lonely nights, the only company is darkness.

lines.zh: 这里，就是我的舞台，我的领地！
lines.en: Here, is where I perform, my domain.

lines.zh: 我在这里等你很久了，别让我失望！
lines.en: I've been waiting for you here for a long time, don't disappoint me.

lines.zh: 在这黑暗中，我是唯一不变的存在！
lines.en: In this darkness, I am the only constant presence.

lines.zh: 你的心跳太快，我听腻了。
lines.en: Your heart beats too fast. I am bored of it.

lines.zh: 岩壁里，我学着你的声音。
lines.en: Inside the rock, I am learning your voice.
Delight makes me tremble in the dark.

lines.zh: 每过一个夜晚，我更完整。
lines.en: With every night that passes, I grow more whole.

lines.zh: 你的眼神，透露出恐惧和绝望！
lines.en: Your eyes show fear and despair.

lines.zh: 你似乎很害怕，很好，这样更好玩！
lines.en: You seem afraid, that only makes it better.

lines.zh: 你的动作，显得那么的无力！
lines.en: Your movements, so helpless.

lines.zh: 你的气息中，充满了恐惧和绝望！
lines.en: Your breath is filled with fear and despair.

lines.zh: 你的眼神，透露出绝望和恐惧！
lines.en: Your eyes show despair and fear.

lines.zh: 你颤抖的双手，让我更加兴奋！
lines.en: Your trembling hands make me more excited.

lines.zh: 你的慌乱，让我更加享受这一刻！
lines.en: Your panic makes this moment even more enjoyable.

lines.zh: 你的眼神中，满是绝望和恐惧！
lines.en: Your eyes are full of despair and fear.

lines.zh: 你害怕的眼神，让我更加兴奋！
lines.en: Your frightened eyes excite me even more.

lines.zh: 你的恐惧，让我更加兴奋！
lines.en: Your fear excites me even more.

lines.zh: 火把的光到不了我这里。
lines.en: Your torchlight never reaches me.
Where are you looking? I am right here.
The deeper you go, the clearer I become.
I can hear how hard you are panting.
The wall behind you is breathing.
Your shadow arrived before you did.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高些，让我瞧瞧。
lines.en: Hold your torch higher, let me have a look.
You have seen this face in your dreams.
Have you counted how many layers this cave has?

lines.zh: 你的名字，我快想起来了。
lines.en: I am about to remember your name.
Echoes of agony from the caves.
Pain tears through my flesh.
Weakness immobilizes me.
Severe pain grips me.
My body convulses.
Pain is unbearable.
I nearly collapse.
Pain reddens my eyes.
I nearly suffocate.
I can't go on any longer.

lines.zh: 你靠近得太近了，我的小甜心。
lines.en: You're getting too close, my little sweetie.

lines.zh: 享受这些片刻吧，它们很快就会结束。
lines.en: Enjoy these moments, they won't last long.

lines.zh: 看我的触手，它们可不友善。
lines.en: Watch my tentacles, they're not friendly.

lines.zh: 我的饥饿感在你身上苏醒。
lines.en: My hunger awakens on you.

lines.zh: 来吧，让我们一起享受这个时刻。
lines.en: Come, let's enjoy this moment together.

lines.zh: 不要害怕，我已经等你很久了。
lines.en: Don't be afraid, I've been waiting for you.
You can't escape my embrace.

lines.zh: 尝尝我的触须，它们很美味。
lines.en: Taste my tentacles, they're delicious.

lines.zh: 我会让你体验痛苦的滋味。
lines.en: I'll let you taste the agony.
Enjoy the last of the pleasure.
Move, or you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 愚蠢的探索者，你打扰了我的安宁。
lines.en: Foolish explorer, you've disturbed my peace.

lines.zh: 别碰我，否则你会付出代价。
lines.en: Don't touch me, or you'll pay the price.

lines.zh: 小心，我的触手会抓住你。
lines.en: Be careful, my tentacles will grab you.

lines.zh: 我的身体会阻碍你前进。
lines.en: My body will block your path.
Step back, or I'll attack you.

lines.zh: 不要靠近，否则你会受伤。
lines.en: Don't come closer, or you'll get hurt.

lines.zh: 我的存在让你无路可逃。
lines.en: My presence leaves you no escape.
Come near me, and you'll be devoured.

lines.zh: 远离我，否则你会遇到危险。
lines.en: Stay away from me, or you'll face danger.
Come, let's procreate.

lines.zh: 我的同类就在附近，准备好交配吧。
lines.en: My kind is nearby, get ready to mate.

lines.zh: 交配是唯一可以减轻我的痛苦。
lines.en: Mating is the only way to relieve my pain.

lines.zh: 与我交配，我可以给你力量。
lines.en: Mate with me, I can give you strength.

lines.zh: 来，让我们一起完成任务。
lines.en: Come, let's complete our task together.

lines.zh: 越演化，我越知道怎么黏。
lines.en: The more I evolve, the better I cling.

lines.zh: 让我们一起创造出新的生命。
lines.en: Let's create new life together.

lines.zh: 交配是唯一能拯救我的方法。
lines.en: Mating is the only way to save me.

lines.zh: 与我交配，我将给予你力量。
lines.en: Mate with me, I'll give you strength.

lines.zh: 完成交配，才能继续我们的旅程。
lines.en: Complete the mating to continue our journey.

lines.zh: 我感觉有股甜味从你身上散开。
lines.en: I can smell the sweetness from you.
Your scent is tempting.
Let me tell you a story, shall we?
Your taste is delightful.
You'll taste sweet in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我会让你成为我的晚餐。
lines.en: You'll be my dinner.

lines.zh: 享受这一刻吧，很快你就会消失。
lines.en: Enjoy this moment, you'll soon be gone.
Your existence is about to end.
I'll help you end your suffering.
You'll merge with my dreams.
The laughter in the cave is mine.
The prey's scent grows stronger.
I have my target.
I'm here, come with me.
This scent is too enticing.
You're trapped now.
I'll devour your soul.
You'll be part of me.
You can't escape my grasp.
I'll enjoy your fear.
You have stepped into my territory.
This prey actually breathes.
The scent came falling down from above.
I can see you shivering at the corner.
The stone layers tell me where you are.

lines.zh: 你走进了最深的这一层。
lines.en: You have walked into the deepest layer.

lines.zh: 我会让你的痛苦持续更久。
lines.en: Your pain will last longer.
You'll be under my shadow.
I'll make you fear.
Your fate is in my hands.
I'll make you taste pain.
You'll fall into the abyss.
I'll devour you forever.
You'll be forgotten in the corner.
You'll be my toy.
You'll be my prisoner.

lines.zh: 我的触手记得你的形状。
lines.en: My tendrils remember your shape.
Slow down, let me take a good look.
Where do you think those legs are running?

lines.zh: 这条隧道只有一个出口。
lines.en: This tunnel has only one exit.

lines.zh: 我会从你脚下的石头出来。
lines.en: I will come out of the stone under your feet.
That laugh you heard was mine.
I am in no hurry. The cave is bigger than you.
Light one spot, and I retreat an inch.
Your torch will not burn much longer.
A few steps more, and you reach my stomach.
Sssss, creeping closer!
Entwined tentacles, excruciating pain!

lines.zh: 洞里待久了，我笑得很开心。
lines.en: Long in these caves, and I smile so happily.
Mucus splatters, corroding skin!
Stabbing you with spines!

lines.zh: 挥动触手，给你致命一击！
lines.en: Swinging tentacles for the kill!
Suction cups hold tight!
Toxic venom injecting, slowly rotting you!
Wrapping tentacles, choking to death!

lines.zh: 尖利的牙齿，撕裂你的肉体！
lines.en: Sharp teeth tearing your flesh!
Tendrils whip out of the cracks!
Slime seals your eyes shut!
I bite through your torch and your arm!
I drag you deep into the rock!
Suckers clamp onto the back of your neck!
Fangs stab down from the dark!
Ground rips, here I am!
Shadow rises from the darkness!
Awakening from the depths!
Wriggling from the rock, ready to hunt!
Sliding between rocks, tracking prey!
Peering in the dark, waiting!
Wriggling underground, closing in!
Crevices revealing me!
Suddenly appearing, silent!
Awaiting in the cave's depths!

lines.zh: 岩层裂开一道缝，我钻出来。
lines.en: A crack opens in the rock, and I slip out.
You have dug deep enough. I am here.

lines.zh: 洞顶滴下的水里，我成形。
lines.en: I take shape in the water dripping from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 深处的黑暗先动了一下。
lines.en: The darkness below moved first.

lines.zh: 我从你身后的矿道爬出。
lines.en: I crawl out of the shaft behind you.
On the third level underground, I opened my eyes.

lines.zh: 石头记住了我，我回来了。
lines.en: The stone remembers me. I am back.
A long enough night makes me grow fast.

lines.zh: 你听见的那口气，是我呼的。
lines.en: That breath you heard was mine.

lines.zh: 欢愉的我，从裂隙里挤出。
lines.en: Delighted, I squeeze out through the fissure.
Lava licks my skin.
Rocks shatter my bones.
Cold water fills my lungs.
Shockwave tears through me.
Arrow pierces my heart.

lines.zh: 魔法火焰烧灼我的灵魂。
lines.en: Magic flames burn my soul.
Starvation weakens me.
Lightning sears my flesh.
Void devours me.
